DEND.limits: No-cross retains multiple cells, self recurrence and state. Success refutes necessity for passing this finite task/gate; failure only shows this recipe/budget did not learn reliably. No physical impossibility or single-cell conclusion.

POINT.limits: No-cross retains multiple cells, self recurrence and state. Success refutes necessity for passing this finite task/gate; failure only shows this recipe/budget did not learn reliably. No physical impossibility or single-cell conclusion.

statistics.uncertainty: Five paired seed blocks; all eight intervals pointwise exploratory without multiple-comparison protection. Degenerate or zero-crossing intervals do not establish equivalence. No hyperparameter search.
